import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch, MagicMock
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

class TestPatientAppointmentWorkflow(unittest.TestCase):

    def setUp(self):
        self.patient_appointment = MagicMock()
        self.workflow_system = MagicMock()
        self.machine_learning_algorithm = MagicMock()
        self.database_manager = MagicMock()
        self.archiving_system = MagicMock()

    @patch('module_name.PatientAppointment')
    @patch('module_name.WorkflowSystem')
    def test_patient_appointment_creation(self, MockWorkflowSystem, MockPatientAppointment):
        # Test for VIRTUA-2.5-2
        MockPatientAppointment.return_value = self.patient_appointment
        MockWorkflowSystem.return_value = self.workflow_system
        patient_appointment = MockPatientAppointment()
        self.assertIsNotNone(patient_appointment)

    @patch('module_name.WorkflowSystem')
    def test_route_patient_consultation_request(self, MockWorkflowSystem):
        # Test for VIRTUA-2.5-3
        MockWorkflowSystem.return_value = self.workflow_system
        self.workflow_system.route_request.return_value = True
        result = self.workflow_system.route_request("Patient1", "Doctor1")
        self.assertTrue(result)

    @patch('module_name.WorkflowSystem')
    def test_route_patient_to_right_chemist(self, MockWorkflowSystem):
        # Test for VIRTUA-2.5-4
        MockWorkflowSystem.return_value = self.workflow_system
        self.workflow_system.route_to_chemist.return_value = "Chemist1"
        result = self.workflow_system.route_to_chemist("Patient1", "123456")
        self.assertEqual(result, "Chemist1")

    @patch('module_name.WorkflowSystem')
    def test_route_patient_to_right_lab(self, MockWorkflowSystem):
        # Test for VIRTUA-2.5-4
        MockWorkflowSystem.return_value = self.workflow_system
        self.workflow_system.route_to_lab.return_value = "Lab1"
        result = self.workflow_system.route_to_lab("Patient1", "123456")
        self.assertEqual(result, "Lab1")

    @patch('module_name.MachineLearningAlgorithm')
    def test_predict_disease_based_on_symptoms(self, MockMachineLearningAlgorithm):
        # Test for VIRTUA-2.5-5
        MockMachineLearningAlgorithm.return_value = self.machine_learning_algorithm
        self.machine_learning_algorithm.predict_disease.return_value = "Disease1"
        result = self.machine_learning_algorithm.predict_disease(["Symptom1", "Symptom2"])
        self.assertEqual(result, "Disease1")

    @patch('module_name.MachineLearningAlgorithm')
    def test_algorithm_training_with_new_data(self, MockMachineLearningAlgorithm):
        # Test for VIRTUA-2.5-6
        MockMachineLearningAlgorithm.return_value = self.machine_learning_algorithm
        self.machine_learning_algorithm.train.return_value = True
        result = self.machine_learning_algorithm.train("NewDataSet")
        self.assertTrue(result)

    @patch('module_name.DatabaseManager')
    def test_database_maintenance_by_administration(self, MockDatabaseManager):
        # Test for VIRTUA-2.5-7
        MockDatabaseManager.return_value = self.database_manager
        self.database_manager.maintain.return_value = True
        result = self.database_manager.maintain()
        self.assertTrue(result)

    @patch('module_name.ArchivingSystem')
    def test_archive_inactive_patients(self, MockArchivingSystem):
        # Test for VIRTUA-2.5-8
        MockArchivingSystem.return_value = self.archiving_system
        self.archiving_system.archive.return_value = True
        last_consultation_date = datetime.now() - timedelta(days=3*365)
        result = self.archiving_system.archive("Patient1", last_consultation_date)
        self.assertTrue(result)

    @patch('module_name.ArchivingSystem')
    def test_do_not_archive_active_patients(self, MockArchivingSystem):
